changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapSequence_backup') BEGIN drop table [dbo].[MapSequence_backup]; END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapSequence_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapSequence_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [MapItemID] [int] NOT NULL, [Sequence] [int] NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapSequence] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) )
END
